tasks.label: Unity: Play Bootstrap
tasks.detail: Opens the editor if needed, opens Bootstrap.unity and enters Play Mode
tasks.command: unity open . --until-ready && unity command scene open --path Assets/_Project/Scenes/Bootstrap.unity && unity command editor.playmode start
